vitrina_lrv: This is the LRV {directo}, the Apollo 17 lunar rover. The astronauts drove it in 1972 {exacto} and it stayed on the Moon. Soon you'll get to explore its mission {cercano}.
vitrina_perseverance: This is Perseverance {directo}, a Mars rover. It landed in Jezero Crater in February 2021 {exacto} and it's still exploring the planet. Soon you'll get to explore its mission {cercano}.
regreso_museo: Great tour {cercano}. When the mission is ready, you'll be able to live it in full.
ayuda: Walk by raising your knees · tilt your head to turn · point at a showcase for 1.5 s · clap to enter
calibracion_instruccion: Look straight ahead, keep your head still and your hands relaxed.
luna_entrando_museo: Apollo 17 simulation: you're in the Taurus-Littrow valley, next to the Challenger lunar module. The lunar rover traveled folded in a bay of the module. Hold the E key to deploy it.
luna_lejos_LRV: Get closer to the rover to climb aboard.
luna_sentado_en_LRV: To move, use W, A, S and D. To get off the LRV, press B. To climb aboard, press space. In real life, the orange soil was much farther away; here it is much closer. Your mission is to collect samples from the orange soil, the one with the blue halo. You can start the mission.
luna_cerca_de_roca: You're next to the rock. Strike it with the hammer.
luna_golpeando: Now close your hand to grab it.
luna_golpe_fallido: You didn't make it in time. Get close again.
luna_muestra_recogida: Sample collected. Clap to return to the museum.
luna_bajado: You got off the rover. Walk around to explore; to climb back aboard, get close and clap.
luna_bajado_muestra: You got off the rover and the sample is still with you. Clap to return to the museum.
opc_suavizado: Cursor smoothing (0.05 very smooth · 1 no filter)
opc_tiempo_oculta_mano: Seconds without seeing the hand before it disappears
opc_umbral_salto_mano: Maximum jump to glide when it reappears (m)
saludo_bienvenida: Hello, explorer! I'm Robi, your space guide in this museum of the future.
saludo_vitrinas: Whenever you're ready, point at one of the showcases to begin the immersion.
saludo_vitrinas_teclado: Whenever you're ready, select one of the showcases with the E key to begin the immersion.
inicio_elige: Choose how you want to play.
inicio_control_camara_desc: Walk by raising your knees, turn by tilting your head and point with your finger. Needs a webcam.
inicio_control_teclado_desc: W A S D to walk, mouse to look around and click to point. Doesn't use the camera.
inicio_camara_fallo: Couldn't use the camera ({error}). You can play with keyboard and mouse, or try the camera again.
ayuda_teclado: W A S D: walk · mouse: look · hold E or click a showcase for 1.5 s · space: clap · F or right click: grab · B: get off the rover · Esc: options
teclado_clic_mirar: Click on the scene to look around with the mouse.
opc_cambiar_control: Change control (returns to the start screen)
luna_entrando_museo_teclado: Apollo 17 simulation: you're in the Taurus-Littrow valley, next to the Challenger lunar module. The lunar rover traveled folded in a bay of the module. Hold the E key to deploy it.
luna_lejos_LRV_teclado: Get closer to the rover and press space to climb aboard.
luna_cerca_de_roca_teclado: You're next to the rock. Strike it with the hammer: press E or click.
luna_suelo_recogido: This orange soil was important because it contains small volcanic glass spheres, formed about 3.5 billion years ago. It was one of the proofs that the Moon had volcanic activity. The LRV was key because it allowed the astronauts to travel up to 8.7 km from the lunar module and reach this crater.
luna_golpeando_teclado: Now grab it: press F or right click.
luna_muestra_recogida_teclado: Sample collected. Press space to return to the museum.
luna_bajado_teclado: You got off the rover. Walk with W to explore; to climb back aboard, get close and press space.
luna_bajado_muestra_teclado: You got off the rover and the sample is still with you. Press space to return to the museum.
luna_mantener_E: Hold E to deploy the LRV
luna_LRV_plegado: The rover is still folded. Hold E to deploy it.
luna_despliegue_liberacion: Schmitt releases the rover from the ladder and Cernan tilts it out by pulling a tape.
luna_despliegue_chasis: At 45 degrees, the rear chassis opens and its wheels spring into place. Then the front chassis opens.
luna_despliegue_bajada: Schmitt lowers the front with the other tape. They pull the pins and move it away from the module.
luna_despliegue_preparacion: They extend the fenders, raise the seats and lower the console.
luna_despliegue_prueba: Cernan powers it up and takes a test drive.
luna_despliegue_carga: Finally they mount the radio, the antennas, the camera and the tools.
luna_LRV_desplegado: The rover is ready. Press space to climb aboard.
luna_LRV_desplegado_teclado: The rover is ready. Get close and press space to climb aboard.
pres_intro: The LRV is an electric vehicle for getting around on the Moon. The astronauts of Apollo 15, 16 and 17 used it.
pres_chasis: The chassis holds the whole vehicle together and folds to fit in the spacecraft.
pres_ruedas: The wheels are made of wire mesh: they cannot go flat and they absorb bumps. The titanium treads grip loose ground.
pres_peso: It weighs 460 pounds on Earth and 76 on the Moon. Its mass does not change.
pres_consola: The console shows the driving data.
pres_comunicaciones: The television camera and the antennas send pictures and signals to Earth.
pres_mando_movimientos: Push to go forward, tilt to turn and pull back to brake. To reverse, first set the switch.
pres_cierre: On Apollo 17, the LRV took the astronauts to the orange soil, volcanic material from the Moon.
pres_listo: You are ready for the mission.
pres_peso_masa: Mass: about 210 kg, the same in both places
pres_distancias: On foot, they could only go a short way from the lander. The LRV let them cover tens of kilometers.
pres_navegacion: With no GPS, the rover found its way with a gyroscope and counted its wheel turns.
pres_energia: The silver-zinc batteries power the motors. The gold Mylar protects the equipment from heat and cold.
luna_suelo_junto: You're next to the orange soil.
cine_despegue_ultimo_trabajo: After helping the astronauts reach much greater distances, the LRV's last job was to use its camera to film our two astronauts as they lifted off from the surface.
cine_despegue_operador: That camera was controlled by an operator back on Earth.
cine_despegue_solo: And the LRV stayed there, alone on the lunar surface: a great success for NASA and for humanity.
luna_despegue_libre: You can keep exploring the valley. Clap to return to the museum.
luna_despegue_libre_teclado: You can keep exploring the valley. Press space to return to the museum.
